rounds.text: The market is actively validating this business through sustained and accelerating momentum, with compounded share price growth scaling from 30% over 10 years and 39% over 5 years up to 53% over the past single year [E16, E17, E18]. This exceptional price performance has driven the stock completely to the peak of its 52-week range at ₹ 178 [E4], reflecting strong, unyielding demand from market participants who recognize underlying value that headline traditional metrics miss. Furthermore, the company maintains a stable 10-year compounded profit growth of 5% [E13], demonstrating long-term operational resilience across economic cycles despite recent short-term volatility. Conceded: the negative trailing twelve-month profit growth of -300% [E15], the negative return on equity of -1.35% [E8], and the absence of a dividend yield at 0.00% [E3] highlight immediate operational hurdles. However, the patient market positioning and multi-year positive share price compounding establish that investors are correctly looking past temporary headwinds toward the broader equity appreciation potential [E16, E17, E18].
